title: Geometrically regular fibres after a Noetherian ind-etale pair colimit
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $I\subseteq A$ an ideal, and $c$ a colimit cocone in the under category of $A$ on the full subcategory of etale maps $A\to D$ for which $A/I\to D/ID$ is bijective [lem-weil-pbc-pair-henselization]. Write $B=c.\mathrm{pt}.\mathrm{right}$ and $f:A\to B$ for its structure map. Assume $B$ is Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Let $C$ be a commutative ring and $g:B\to C$ any homomorphism. If $g\circ f$ is regular [def-weil-pbc-g-ring], then for every prime $q$ of $B$, $\kappa(q)\otimes_B C$ with the algebra structure induced by $g$ is geometrically regular over $\kappa(q)$ [def-weil-pbc-g-ring]. No flatness of $g$, henselian-pair hypothesis on $B$, G-ring hypothesis, or completion is assumed.

source.place: Tag 0AH3, displayed product of completed fibres and following paragraph; the calculation applies to any B-algebra C. Uses Tag 0AH1 and Algebra Tag 07QH; checked on the Stacks tag pages.

proof.text: For q, let p be its contraction. Construct the canonical residue map rho and the kappa(p)-algebra map phi from p.Fiber C to q.Fiber C by the tensor universal property. Check explicitly on pure tensors that phi sends x tensor y to rho(x) tensor y. Apply the structural fibre-localization theorem, obtaining separable algebraicity and an IsLocalization witness for phi.
The geometrically regular p fibre of the composite is hregular.2 p, by the definition of a regular ring map.

Prove geometric regularity is preserved by localization. Noetherianity of the localized algebra follows from IsLocalization.isNoetherianRing. For every finite purely inseparable extension K, the map K tensor_k R to K tensor_k S is a localization at the image of M, using IsLocalization.tensorProduct_tensorProduct_right and the explicit tensor-map compatibility. Apply regularity of localizations to the regular source. The private regular_localization helper supplies the fraction and kernel axioms from IsLocalization to the existing regular-localization theorem.

Apply the preceding localization argument to phi to obtain geometric regularity of q.Fiber C over kappa(p), including Noetherianity. The compatible tower through kappa(q) is the canonical tensor-product left algebra. Apply the forward direction of geometric regularity over a separable algebraic extension to get geometric regularity over kappa(q).

lean.statement:
theorem pair_henselization_regular_fibers
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A)
    (c : Cocone (ObjectProperty.ι
      (fun D : Under (CommRingCat.of A) ↦
        AlgebraicGeometry.Etale (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map D.hom) ∧
          Function.Bijective (Ideal.quotientMap (I.map D.hom.hom) D.hom.hom
            (Ideal.le_comap_map)))))
    (hc : IsColimit c) [IsNoetherianRing c.pt.right]
    (C : Type u) [CommRing C] (g : c.pt.right →+* C)
    (hregular : (g.comp c.pt.hom.hom).IsRegular) :
    letI := g.toAlgebra
    ∀ (q : Ideal c.pt.right) [q.IsPrime],
      Algebra.IsGeometricallyRegular q.ResidueField (q.Fiber C)
